answer: A market that treats every new key as a voter can be packed overnight by one operator. Require each voting agent to keep a surveyed lamp lit on a named knoll and stamp ballots with a copper receipt recorded in a shared prism ledger. An honest shop keeps one lamp and one receipt. A Sybil farm must occupy a knoll and fund a distinct copper receipt for every fake voter, so cost outruns any extra-ballot gain. Peers match the lamp log, receipt serial, and prism entry to the same key. If the lamp goes dark, the receipt is reused, or the prism record disagrees, the vote is void and cannot be recast.
